title: Alerts BI team registry
description: Versioned ownership registry (design section 3.1). Ownership is a supplied list of operator values; nothing is parsed or inferred to establish it.

registry_version.description: Bumped whenever any ownership mapping changes, so 'their behaviour changed' stays distinguishable from 'we edited the mapping'.

effective_date.description: Date this registry version took effect (UTC calendar date).

team_id.description: Stable identifier. Never reused for a different team.

v1_operators.description: Exact, case-sensitive v1 operator values. May be empty after migration. Case variants used by one team are listed explicitly.

v2_operator.description: Exact v2 operator, derived from the team's API key. Null before migration.

panels.description: Optional supplied Grafana panel queries, used only for suppression detection (design section 5.2). Never for ownership.

enabled.description: When true, `alerts-bi weekly` runs and publishes this team's review for every Monday-to-Monday UTC week (design section 7.11). Absent means false.

v1_rule_effort_days.description: Working days to rebuild one v1 alert rule in the v2 schema, for the time-to-v2 effort figure (team summary spec section 7.2). Absent means the default in src.config.planning.

variables.description: Frozen variable definitions supplied with the registry. The MVP never calls Grafana.

type.description: Only custom, constant and interval resolve. A query variable is never executed and makes its suppression leaf unmeasured.

value.description: Single resolved value for constant/interval variables.

values.description: Complete selected-value list for a multi-value custom variable.

all_selected.description: True when the panel had '$__all' selected. Expanding to everything is exactly the blast-radius failure mode guarded in design section 5.2.
